title: The Morning Catch

intro.speaker: mara
intro.text: We've anchored by a fishing village, and the boats are coming in with the morning catch!

intro.speaker: mara
intro.text: The fishers sell fish in baskets of five. Will you help count them in?

steps.speaker: mara
steps.prompt: Put five fish in each basket. Count as you go.
steps.hint: Find a basket with an empty dip, and put a fish there.

older.prompt: Ten fish in each basket, three baskets. No dips to help: count in tens.

feedback.full: That basket is full. Try the next one.
feedback.all_good: Four baskets of five: twenty fish for the village!

outro.speaker: mara
outro.text: Twenty fish! The fishers say thank you, and they've given us one basket to take home.

journal_line: I counted the morning catch into baskets with Captain Mara.

outro.speaker: mara
outro.text: Three baskets of ten: thirty fish! Counting in tens is a sailor's trick.
